title: curie <tier> overrides --json
description: The agent-facing payload of `curie <tier> overrides <agent>`: the dry-run plan, or the agent's nullable operator overrides as the API stored them. `model`, `thinking`, `execution_deadline_seconds`, and `runner_resources` are null when the platform default applies; `reviewer_model` is null when the credential's default applies. `memory_writes` is the agent's memory-tools switch, always a boolean. `agent_wide_learning` is the agent's independent agent-wide learning opt-in (ADR 0239), always a boolean. `learned_skills` is the agent's learned-skills switch (ADR 0237), always a boolean. `agent_schedules`, `schedule_timezone`, `schedule_max_active`, and `schedule_min_interval_minutes` are the agent's stored ADR 0238 schedule settings. `changed` is false for an inspect (no change flags passed) and true when this invocation wrote, so a consumer can tell "this is what it is" from "this is what it now is" without diffing.
